author: fixture-author
scope: Synthetic complete finite clause checklist; no real subject or provider inference result.
dimension: Ordered extent of satisfaction of the declared required clauses.

orderingReview.meaning: None of the declared clauses is satisfied.
A nonempty proper subset of the declared clauses is satisfied; some excludes all.
Every declared required clause is satisfied.

directionReview: The ordinal indices and quality ranks strictly increase from none through partial to full satisfaction.
projectionReview: Quality 0 maps to FAIL; quality 1 maps to PASS; intermediate expectations map to ABSTAIN. Missing provider answers are instrument ERROR. These are explicit conservative fixture boundaries, not empirically selected thresholds.
limits: The provider score is an expected ordinal index, not a count of satisfied clauses, degree measured on equal semantic intervals, probability of satisfaction or certainty.
The review establishes rubric ordering and declared projection coherence only. It does not certify evidence sufficiency for an arbitrary new requirement.
No live model behavior, local calibration, comparative primitive preference or real-system compliance is established.
